## Highlights

- Give Desktop Settings native icon tabs and group Behavior into Limits, Toolbar, MCP, OpenCode preferences, and Desktop presentation. Show Global or Worktree scope in the header on tabs where it matters.
- Align settings actions and compact numeric fields. At narrow widths, move the controls below their labels without clipping them. Keep unsaved drafts when switching tabs.
- Show the update status beside the running Navigator version in About, with help and release notes in separate groups.

## Upgrade notes

Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator. The existing Navigator Corners font requirement and Text fallback are unchanged.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/compare/v0.27.9...v1.0.0

## Highlights

- Remove the extra outer scrollbar from Desktop Navigator Settings. Keep native settings scrolling and keyboard drag-order announcements without allowing the page to scroll into blank space.
- Add startup skeletons for initially expanded Desktop sections, using measured control and text geometry. Keep existing rows mounted and hidden controls out of keyboard focus while data arrives. Remember numeric geometry within the window across plugin reloads; ordinary refreshes, later section expansion and Float/Dock do not restart skeletons.

## Upgrade notes

Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator. The existing Navigator Corners font requirement and Text fallback are unchanged.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/compare/v0.27.8...v0.27.9

## Highlights

- Add Code Mode activity inside MCP or in a separate sidebar section in Desktop and TUI. Browse active and recent execute runs, compact source references marked In code, and Code/Response/Error views with full public JSON and independent scrolling. Unknown references and unavailable nested calls remain explicit.
- Preview and confirm per-server Code Mode/Direct routing changes without changing connection state. Preserve comments and unrelated fields in both native and supported legacy configuration files.
- Keep MCP routing, information and connection controls aligned as errors, labels and pending states change. Loading indicators replace connection controls in place without extra captions or rows. Multiline Code Mode entries no longer overlap, and TUI summaries keep status and duration readable.
- Present Desktop configuration, preset, import, project-profile and Todo-enablement previews with native controls and a clearer hierarchy while preserving review, back, cancel and explicit confirmation.
- Round displayed credit balances to two decimal places while preserving the provider's original precision and distinct missing/unlimited states.

## Upgrade notes

Restart OpenCode after updating Navigator. The existing Navigator Corners font requirement and Text fallback are unchanged.

## Highlights

- Refine Limits in Desktop and TUI: show the provider before the update time, use icon-only quota and period rows, give the two scales one outer rounded contour, and keep reset-time switching on its own row.
- Show Codex's native account credit balance without mixing it with Banked Resets. Preserve the provider's precision, explicit zero and unlimited state; missing balances remain unknown.
- Keep existing idle child sessions visible in Recent when their execution happened before monitoring started. Do not invent run timing or outcomes; Desktop opens Recent when Active is empty and recent children exist.

releases.name: v0.27.6 — Compact Limits and reset-time switching
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Limits is more compact in Desktop and TUI: window icons and quota values sit above the adjacent quota and blue period scales, with native provider credit balances below.
- Reset time appears once. Activate its swap-icon row to switch between the relative countdown and absolute reset date/time, without refreshing the provider.
- The selected time format survives quota refreshes. Keyboard users can press Enter in TUI, or Enter/Space on Desktop's native button; missing and invalid dates remain explicit.

## Upgrade notes

- Restart existing OpenCode clients after the Navigator update to ensure they load the new plugin. No OpenCode or theme update is required.
- Quota pace thresholds, provider-native balance units, Banked Resets and confirmed credit consumption are unchanged.
- The Navigator Corners font requirement for rounded multiline terminal selections is unchanged.

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at e9622a8c185c2ad104d3b05b01b8f29defccb6e7 -->

## What's Changed
* Compact Limits scales and toggle reset-time display by @St1ggy in https://github.com/St1ggy/opencode-navigator/pull/49
